answer: Because the timing is recorded against the gale challenge, the beacon audit can replay the dune history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 198 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3036 identities would post 3152 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
